'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Phil Aasen DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Phil Aasen]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Username:''' Korreshark
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
